creator.description:
Identifying disinfo, scapegoating, and harmful rhetoric to keep Bluesky safer.

DMs open for questions/suggestions.

Support: https://ko-fi.com/shadowbanner

locales.description: Defends, minimizes, or justifies abuse—such as sexual abuse, domestic violence, or child abuse—by excusing perpetrators or downplaying harm.
locales.name: Abuse Apologia

locales.description: Expresses ableism through slurs, derogatory language, or mockery of people with disabilities—including insults tied to cognitive, developmental, or physical differences.
locales.name: Ableism

locales.description: Expresses anti-Asian bias, stereotypes, or Sinophobic tropes—including scapegoating and dehumanization.
locales.name: Anti-Asian Bias

locales.description: Expresses anti-Black bias, slurs, or dehumanizing views—including those targeting African-Americans, Afro-Caribbeans, or Black communities worldwide.
locales.name: Anti-Black Racism

locales.description: Expresses antisemitic views, stereotypes, slurs, or hatred targeting Jewish people.
locales.name: Antisemitism

locales.description: Mocks or demeans people based on body size, weight, or appearance.
locales.name: Body Shaming

locales.description: Blames Dearborn/Muslim or “uncommitted” voters for 2024 election outcomes (including Kamala Harris’s loss), treating them as collectively responsible.
locales.name: Dearborn Scapegoating

locales.description: Engages in bad-faith debating tactics (e.g., goalpost-shifting, sea-lioning, Red Scare/anti-socialist cudgels) to derail conversation.
locales.name: Debate Lord

locales.description: Defends or minimizes failures by liberal/centrist parties or leaders (e.g., Democrats, Labour, Liberals) via deflection, lower expectations, or false equivalences.
locales.name: Liberal Apologia

locales.description: Denies or dismisses U.S. complicity in genocide—ignoring roles in arms, aid, or diplomatic cover, or recognizing it only selectively for partisan reasons.
locales.name: Denies U.S. Genocide Role

locales.description: Discredits or attacks grassroots fundraisers for Palestinians in Gaza—or those who amplify them—by portraying them as scams or support for terrorism.
locales.name: Gaza Aid Smear

locales.description: Spreads or amplifies (e.g., via reposts/boosts) disinformation that delegitimizes Palestinian suffering or evidence of war crimes (e.g., “Gazawood/Pallywood”).
locales.name: Gaza Disinfo Spreader

locales.description: Denies, minimizes, or deflects the genocide of Palestinians in Gaza—including refusal to use the term “genocide,” whataboutism, or claims it’s merely “war crimes.”
locales.name: Gaza Genocide Denier

locales.description: Supports or endorses genocidal violence against Palestinians in Gaza—including framing extermination, expulsion, or 'clean out' operations as necessary or righteous.
locales.name: Gaza Genocide Supporter

locales.description: Mocks or trivializes the suffering, displacement, or genocide of Palestinians in Gaza.
locales.name: Gaza Mockery

locales.description: Follows an account identified for promoting “Gazawood”-style disinformation that dismisses authentic documentation from Gaza.
locales.name: Gazawood Disinfo Follower

locales.description: Mocks, gloats over, or takes pleasure in others’ suffering; often frames harm as deserved (“FAFO”) or blames entire communities for outcomes.
locales.name: Gloats Over Harm

locales.description: Expresses homophobic slurs, stereotypes, or hostility toward gay, lesbian, or queer people.
locales.name: Homophobia

locales.description: Expresses anti-Muslim bias, stereotypes, or hatred.
locales.name: Islamophobia

locales.description: Justifies or defends Israeli military aggression or state violence by downplaying harm, deflecting criticism, or framing Palestinian resistance as illegitimate.
locales.name: Israel Apologia

locales.description: Blames Latino voters or communities for election outcomes or policy setbacks—treating them as collectively responsible while erasing diversity.
locales.name: Latino Scapegoating

locales.description: Blames leftists or progressives for political losses—framing them as responsible for setbacks while dismissing establishment failures.
locales.name: Leftist Scapegoating

locales.description: Promotes conspiracy theories from a liberal/centrist perspective—such as claims that Harris secretly won, foreign powers orchestrated her loss, or protests were staged.
locales.name: Liberal Conspiracism

locales.description: Engages in pro-Trump trolling or promotion—slogans, culture-war bait, or conspiratorial rhetoric that derails conversation.
locales.name: MAGA Troll

locales.description: Expresses misogynistic slurs, insults, or hostility targeting women—including gender-based dismissal, mockery, or stereotypes.
locales.name: Misogyny

locales.description: Floods Bluesky with repetitive political memes or low-effort content—including AI-generated memes—that derail or replace real discussion.
locales.name: Political Spammer

locales.description: Expresses racist slurs, stereotypes, or dehumanization—used as a general fallback when no more specific label fits.
locales.name: Racism

locales.description: Engages in troll-like behavior from a liberal/centrist stance—mocking or baiting leftists in bad faith rather than debating sincerely.
locales.name: Liberal Troll

locales.description: Derails conversations with endless, insincere questions or demands for evidence while feigning good-faith curiosity.
locales.name: Sea-Lioning

locales.description: Justifies or excuses violence by states—past or present—by downplaying harm, deflecting criticism, or portraying repression as legitimate.
locales.name: State Violence Apologia

locales.description: Blames trans rights or visibility for electoral losses or liberal/centrist party failures—treating trans people as a political liability.
locales.name: Trans Scapegoating

locales.description: Expresses transphobic slurs, insults, or hostility—denying trans identities, demeaning trans people, or revoking “allyship” as punishment for political disagreement.
locales.name: Transphobia

locales.description: Uses false or unsubstantiated allegations of abuse—including pedojacketing—as a tactic to discredit or harm others.
locales.name: Weaponizes Abuse

locales.description: Uses accusations of antisemitism in bad faith to silence or delegitimize criticism of Israel, Zionism, or U.S. foreign policy.
locales.name: Weaponizes Antisemitism

locales.description: Misuses accusations of racism in bad faith—such as shielding powerful figures from critique or claiming “reverse racism” against white people.
locales.name: Weaponizes Racism
